title: Audio feedback
description: The app's facts for the audio-and-haptics-feedback checkers. Optional: without it, react-native-audio-api must be pinned to the version the checker was verified on (0.13.6) and no recorded audio file may ship.

audioApiVersion.description: The exact react-native-audio-api version this app verified with the before-any-bump checklist (release notes, plugin defaults, the Jest mock, adapter tests, a smoke test on a named iOS simulator and Android emulator, a listening check). package.json must pin exactly this version.

bundledSounds.description: Recorded feedback sounds the audio adapter decodes (opt-in; synthesized recipes are the default). Each file is a local asset with its licence and source; feedback sounds never stream from the network.

file.description: Repo-relative path, for example assets/sounds/complete.wav. WAV (PCM), MP3 or FLAC only: with disableFFmpeg and disableStaticExternalLibs, react-native-audio-api decodes nothing else (CAF, M4A/AAC and OGG/Opus stay silent).

license.description: SPDX id or licence name, for example CC0-1.0.

source.description: Where it came from: a URL, a vendor or 'recorded by the team'.

otherAudio.description: Recorded audio the app ships that is not feedback: a notification sound (expo-notifications plays it, not the feedback engine) or a media file a feature plays with expo-audio or expo-video. Listed so every shipped audio file has a licence and a source; the feedback adapter never decodes these.

purpose.description: notification: a notification or channel sound; media: content a feature plays (a podcast intro, a video soundtrack).

license.description: SPDX id or licence name, for example CC0-1.0.

source.description: Where it came from: a URL, a vendor or 'recorded by the team'.
